# Customizations are shared if no cookie are sent

When the browser doesn't send cookies and you save a customization, if another browser that doesn't send cookie open the product detail page, it will see the customization.

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2168836/183050931-28a7ed7b-179a-49e3-8dde-13d237eb4635.mov

## Attendu
Customizations shouldn't be saved if the server doesn't receive the cookie

## Étapes
1. Disable the cookie in the settings of your browser (see on the screen record to know how to do it)
2. As a guest, save a customization for the customizable mug for instance
3. In a private session or another browser that have cookie disabled, visit the customizable mug detail page
4. See that the customization is here
